anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-radius convex arc forming a small, rounded melon profile at the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby beak with a width-to-length ratio approximately 1:1 from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic green surface coloration and total absence of a visible dorsal fin structure.
